sql.if: AND target_id IN ( SELECT from_animal_cage_id FROM cage_transfer_log WHERE occupant_id = #{personId} AND from_animal_cage_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT to_animal_cage_id FROM cage_transfer_log WHERE occupant_id = #{personId} AND to_animal_cage_id IS NOT NULL )

AND ( entity_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR entity_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR field_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR field_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR target_label LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR before_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR after_value LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_form_audit_log ( category, change_type, entity, entity_id, entity_code, entity_name, target_type, target_id, target_label, field_code, field_name, before_value, after_value, before_json, after_json, operator_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{category}, #{changeType}, #{entity}, #{entityId}, #{entityCode}, #{entityName}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetLabel}, #{fieldCode}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{beforeJson}, #{afterJson}, #{operatorId}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM cage_form_audit_log
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT target_id AS targetId, change_type AS changeType, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, MAX(operator_id) AS operatorId, COUNT(*) AS fieldCount, MIN(id) AS firstId FROM cage_form_audit_log
GROUP BY target_id, change_type, created_at ORDER BY firstId DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM cage_form_audit_log
GROUP BY target_id, change_type, created_at ) t

SELECT a.* FROM cage_form_audit_log a JOIN ( SELECT target_id, change_type, created_at, MIN(id) AS firstId FROM cage_form_audit_log
GROUP BY target_id, change_type, created_at ORDER BY firstId DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) g ON g.target_id = a.target_id AND g.change_type = a.change_type AND g.created_at = a.created_at
AND a.category = #{category}
AND (a.operator_id IS NULL OR a.operator_id <> 'SYNC')
AND a.operator_id = 'SYNC'
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id ASC
